categoryName: Footwear — school shoes, slippers, sports, sandals, formal, gumboots for monsoon, socks, polish & care

skuLines.line: School shoes — black, velcro, small kids (size 4-10 / UK 24-32)
skuLines.examples: Bata School (Naughty Boy), Liberty Prefect, Paragon School World, Action School
skuLines.packSizes: single pair, boxed; buy in size runs of 6-8 sizes
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr session start; second spike Sep-Oct as shoes blow out mid-year
skuLines.notes: Velcro is non-negotiable below ~age 8 — hostel wardens cannot tie 40 pairs of laces. Size DEPTH, not brand breadth, is the real stock decision: a 5,000-resident school needs every size in every month, and a missing size means a trip to Solan/Nahan. Bulky, low value density — freight per pair on hill road is real, pre-buy the season.

skuLines.line: School shoes — black, lace, junior/senior (UK 1-9)
skuLines.examples: Liberty Force 10/Prefect, Bata School, Lakhani, Campus school range
skuLines.notes: Senior students (13-18) grow a half-size a term — carry half sizes. Synthetic upper survives monsoon better than genuine leather, which grows mould in an unheated hostel almirah.

skuLines.line: School shoes — girls' black bar shoe / Mary Jane
skuLines.examples: Bata Mary Jane, Relaxo Schoolmate, Liberty Footfun, Paragon School World girls
skuLines.notes: Separate size curve from boys' — do not treat as a colour variant of the same SKU.

skuLines.line: White canvas PT shoes — lace, all school sizes
skuLines.examples: Trendmode canvas, SIMATA canvas lace, Prefect by Liberty, Glory canvas
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr; again before annual sports day / Republic Day drill
skuLines.notes: The cheapest, fastest-dying school SKU and the one whitener sells off. Sports day and parade dates create a hard, dated demand spike — miss it and 300 children are non-uniform on the day.

skuLines.line: White canvas PT shoes — velcro, small kids
skuLines.examples: Shoegears velcro canvas, School Birds, Trendmode velcro
skuLines.notes: Same logic as black velcro — under-8s cannot lace.

skuLines.line: School sports shoe — white PU/mesh non-canvas (senior PT)
skuLines.examples: Campus school/sports, Sparx, Asian, Lotto school
skuLines.notes: Aspirational upgrade for seniors who refuse canvas; the trade-up SKU that keeps the older student from buying in town.

skuLines.line: School socks — white mid-calf, cotton, multipack
skuLines.examples: Jockey school, Bonjour, Dollar, Rupa, CLASSO multipack
skuLines.notes: Highest-repeat line in the whole category — hostel laundry loses socks constantly. Sell only in multipacks; single pairs create a counting nightmare and lower basket.

skuLines.line: School socks — grey/navy with uniform stripe, knee-high (girls)
skuLines.examples: Bonjour school, Wens, Keyter school stripe, Balenzia kids
skuLines.notes: Uniform-spec colour/stripe must match the Akal Academy spec exactly — a near-miss shade is dead stock nobody else on campus can wear. Confirm the spec with the school before buying depth.

skuLines.line: Woolen / thermal socks — adult and kids
skuLines.examples: Supersox thermal, Balenzia woolen, Suprix thermal, local Ludhiana woolen
skuLines.notes: Sirmaur hill winter makes this a survival item, not a comfort one — a 1,500-child residential school in an unheated dorm goes through thick socks. Buy Sep, because a Dec stock-out cannot be fixed from a 30-50 km hill road in snow.

skuLines.line: Sports / ankle socks — white and black cotton
skuLines.examples: Nivia, Supersox ankle, Dollar, Jockey ankle
skuLines.notes: University hostel staple; pairs with running shoes as an attachment sell.

skuLines.line: Formal / dress socks — dark cotton-blend, staff
skuLines.examples: Bonjour formal, Van Heusen, Jockey formal, Balenzia
skuLines.notes: Teaching staff wear formals daily; dark socks are a quiet, high-margin repeat line.

skuLines.line: Hawaii rubber slippers — men
skuLines.examples: Relaxo Hawaii, Paragon Hawaii, Aqualite, Ajanta
skuLines.notes: The single highest-unit footwear SKU in any Indian residential campus. MRP-printed and price-shopped, so margin is thin — it is a footfall driver, not a profit line. Sikh institution: shoes come off at every Gurdwara entry, several times a day, so slip-ons out-turn laced footwear by a wide multiple here.

skuLines.line: Hawaii rubber slippers — women / girls
skuLines.examples: Relaxo Hawaii ladies, Paragon Solea, Bahamas, Aqualite
skuLines.notes: Do not under-buy small adult sizes (4-6) — university girls and staff wives share that band.

skuLines.line: Hawaii / basic slippers — kids small sizes
skuLines.examples: Relaxo Schoolmate slippers, Paragon kids, Aqualite kids
skuLines.notes: Married-staff families with small children buy these constantly and cannot substitute an adult size.

skuLines.line: Soft EVA cushion slippers — men (extra-soft comfort)
skuLines.examples: Doctor Extra Soft, Paragon Solea Plus, Relaxo Flite, Aqualite EVA
skuLines.notes: The trade-up from Hawaii and where the real slipper margin sits. Push this rather than fighting on Hawaii price.

skuLines.line: Soft EVA cushion slippers — women
skuLines.examples: Relaxo Flite ladies, Doctor Extra Soft, Paragon Solea, Ortho+Rest
skuLines.notes: Kitchen and canteen staff stand all day — cushioning is the selling point, not looks.

skuLines.line: Bathroom / shower slippers — EVA clog or strap, hostel
skuLines.examples: CLYMB EVA clog, Smoothlite, Stepzy, YUNIKO, generic EVA bath slipper
skuLines.packSizes: single pair; sell in size-run cartons
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; hard spike at every new-session intake (Mar-Apr, and Jul for university)
skuLines.notes: Shared hostel bathrooms make this compulsory kit, effectively on the school's own packing list. Anti-skid sole matters — wet stone floors. Cheap, high-margin, and every single new admission buys one.

skuLines.line: Sliders / fashion flip-flops — youth
skuLines.examples: Sparx sliders, Campus sliders, Relaxo Bahamas, Adidas/Puma slides
skuLines.notes: The 18-25 cohort's brand-visible purchase — this is the line that stops a wallet leaking to a Chandigarh trip. Carry two or three logo brands even at thin margin.

skuLines.line: Closed / fur-lined room slippers — winter indoor
skuLines.examples: generic fur bootie slipper, Doctor Extra Soft warm, imported plush room slipper
skuLines.notes: Cold stone floors in staff quarters make this a Himachal must-have that a plains buying pattern would completely miss. Strictly seasonal: buy Sep, clear by Feb or carry it 8 months.

skuLines.line: Ortho / MCR / diabetic comfort chappal
skuLines.examples: MCR Health Care, Doctor Extra Soft Ortho, Ortho+Rest, Dr Plus
skuLines.notes: Small units, good margin, and the alternative for the resident is a specialist shop 50 km away. Do not make medical claims — sell it as cushioned comfort footwear.

skuLines.line: Sports sandals / floaters — men
skuLines.examples: Sparx floaters, Paragon Stimulus/Vertex, Aqualite, Campus sandals
skuLines.notes: The workhorse hill-campus shoe: walks a wet path, dries fast, comes off at the Gurdwara in one motion.

skuLines.line: Casual sandals — women / girls
skuLines.examples: Shezone, Paragon Solea, Bata Comfit, Metro/Mochi value lines
skuLines.notes: Style churn is fast — buy shallow across several designs rather than deep on one.

skuLines.line: Kids sandals — closed-toe velcro
skuLines.examples: Relaxo Schoolmate, Paragon kids, Liberty Footfun, Bata Bubblegummers
skuLines.notes: Closed toe only — open-toe kids' sandals on hill gravel means stubbed toes and returns.

skuLines.line: Baby booties / soft-sole first shoes (0-12 m)
skuLines.examples: Bubblegummers infant, Babyhug booties, Mothercare-style soft booties, knitted woolen booties
skuLines.packSizes: single pair or pack of 2 socks-shoes
skuLines.notes: Married staff quarters mean a steady infant population with nowhere else to buy. Tiny cube, high margin, near-zero freight cost — one of the best value-density lines in the whole category. Stock woolen booties for winter specifically.

skuLines.line: Toddler pre-walker & first walking shoes (1-3 y)
skuLines.examples: Bata Bubblegummers, Babyhug, Liberty Footfun, Campus kids
skuLines.notes: Feet grow every 2-3 months, so it is a repeat purchase disguised as a one-off. Soft, flexible, non-slip sole.

skuLines.line: Gumboots — adult PVC, knee-high
skuLines.examples: Duckback/Hillson, Liberty Warrior, Handu ISI, Foot Trends PVC, Vaultex
skuLines.seasonality: Jun-Sep monsoon; secondary in snow/slush Dec-Jan
skuLines.notes: Heavy Himachal monsoon on unpaved paths — this is the defining seasonal line for this location and the one a plains assortment gets wrong. Order Apr-May: mid-monsoon replenishment on a landslide-prone hill road is exactly when you cannot get stock in. Bulky, so freight-plan it. Check for a BIS/ISI mark on the industrial variants.

skuLines.line: Gumboots — kids, ankle and knee-high
skuLines.examples: Duckback kids, generic printed kids' rain boots, Aqualite kids rain
skuLines.notes: 1,000+ children walking to class in monsoon; sizes sell out in one week if under-bought. PVC stiffens and cracks in cold — do not carry monsoon stock through to next June, and store away from a cold outer wall.

skuLines.line: Rain clogs / EVA garden clogs — waterproof slip-on
skuLines.examples: Aqualite EVA clog, Smoothlite garden clog, Crocs-style generic, Paragon rainy
skuLines.notes: One of the biggest 2025-26 growth shapes in India; washes clean, dries in minutes, no laces. Fits the Gurdwara on-off routine perfectly.

skuLines.line: Jelly / PVC fashion sandals — girls and women, monsoon
skuLines.examples: generic jelly sandal, Bahamas PVC, Zoom PVC sandal
skuLines.notes: Cheap, colourful, waterproof — sells on impulse to the school-girl cohort during monsoon.

skuLines.line: Quick-dry velcro waterproof floater — monsoon utility
skuLines.examples: Zoom Shoes waterproof velcro, Ajanta Peshawari waterproof, Sparx rainy
skuLines.notes: For the resident who wants monsoon-proof but will not wear a gumboot to a lecture.

skuLines.line: Running / training shoes — value tier
skuLines.examples: Campus running ₹949+, Sparx, Asian, Aqualite sports
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; spikes at session start and pre-sports-day
skuLines.notes: The volume athletic price point in India; Campus/Sparx sizes 6-10 cover most of the demand.

skuLines.line: Running / training shoes — mid & premium tier
skuLines.examples: Campus ÉLAN, Puma, Adidas, Nivia, HRX
skuLines.notes: Carry thin — 2-3 SKUs, popular sizes only. Its job is to keep the aspirational buyer on campus, and premium now holds roughly half the Indian footwear market by value. Capital-heavy per pair, so do not build depth.

skuLines.line: Sneakers / casual lifestyle shoes
skuLines.examples: Campus sneakers ₹1,079+, Sparx, Bata North Star, Liberty Leap7X
skuLines.notes: White and chunky retro-runner shapes are the 2026 sellers; the 18-25 cohort is the whole market for this line.

skuLines.line: Court / indoor non-marking shoes (badminton, volleyball, basketball)
skuLines.examples: Nivia court, Campus court ₹1,650, Yonex value, Feroc
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; tournament and inter-house sports dates
skuLines.notes: Non-marking sole is usually a condition of using the school's indoor hall — a genuine can't-substitute item. Ask the sports department for its fixture calendar and buy against it.

skuLines.line: Football / hockey studs and turf shoes
skuLines.examples: Nivia Dominator, Vector X, Feroc studs, Sega
skuLines.notes: Buy against the actual team roster, not on speculation — narrow size demand, and dead stock if the fixture is cancelled.

skuLines.line: Kabaddi / wrestling / gym flat shoes
skuLines.examples: Nivia kabaddi, Vector X gym, Sega flats
skuLines.notes: Kabaddi is a real Punjab/Himachal school sport — worth a token depth if the academy fields a team.

skuLines.line: Trekking / hiking shoes — mid-ankle, hill terrain
skuLines.examples: Quechua/Forclaz (Decathlon), Wildcraft, Campus outdoor, Woodland
skuLines.notes: The location itself creates this demand — hill campus, NSS/NCC treks, staff on field duty. Nobody would stock it in a plains township. Waterproof/high-ankle variants sell hardest just before monsoon and winter.

skuLines.line: Walking / comfort shoes — staff and elderly
skuLines.examples: Sparx walking, Bata Comfit, Liberty Healers, Campus walking
skuLines.notes: Long walks on graded campus roads; wide-fit and cushioned outsole are the ask.

skuLines.line: Men's formal leather-look shoes — derby/oxford, black & brown
skuLines.examples: Bata formal, Liberty Fortune/Windsor, Red Chief value, Hush Puppies entry
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; spike before convocation, Founder's Day, wedding season Nov-Feb
skuLines.notes: Teaching and admin staff need this and currently have to make a town trip for it. Genuine leather grows mould in monsoon in an unheated store — prefer synthetic/PU here, keep stock off the floor and rotate. Note that some Sikh residents avoid leather; carry a non-leather formal option deliberately.

skuLines.line: Men's formal slip-on / loafer
skuLines.examples: Bata slip-on, Liberty Fortune loafer, Paragon Escoute, Red Chief loafer
skuLines.notes: Should outsell laced formals on this campus for one specific reason: footwear comes off and on at Gurdwara entry many times a day. Weight the buy towards slip-ons.

skuLines.line: Men's semi-formal / casual shoes & moccasins
skuLines.examples: Paragon Escoute, Bata casual, Liberty Healers, Campus ÉLAN loafer
skuLines.notes: Bridges the formal-and-sneaker gap for younger staff and postgrads.

skuLines.line: Women's bellies / ballerinas / flats
skuLines.examples: Shezone, Bata Comfit bellies, Metro value, ANOUK flats
skuLines.notes: Works with salwar-kameez, which is the daily norm here — the single most useful women's SKU line after slippers. Slip-on, modest, good margin.

skuLines.line: Women's wedges / low block-heel sandals — occasion
skuLines.examples: Shezone wedges, Catwalk value, Metro/Mochi, Bata Marie Claire
skuLines.notes: Buy shallow and event-timed. Heels on graded hill roads limit everyday demand — this is an occasion purchase, not a commute one.

skuLines.line: Punjabi jutti / mojari — men
skuLines.examples: Ekaaya jutti, Traditional Funda, local Patiala/Amritsar jutti, Ajanta Peshawari
skuLines.seasonality: Gurpurab, Baisakhi, Nagar Kirtan, Nov-Feb wedding season
skuLines.notes: This is the culturally load-bearing line for a Kalgidhar Trust township and a plains-modern-trade assortment would leave it out entirely. Slip-on, traditional, worn for religious and formal occasions; source non-leather (rexine/khussa) variants alongside leather so residents who avoid leather are served. Local Punjab sourcing gives the best margin in the category.

skuLines.line: Punjabi jutti — women, embroidered
skuLines.examples: Ekaaya ladies jutti, Jaipur Divinecraft, Phulkari-work jutti, local Amritsar
skuLines.notes: Pairs with salwar-kameez and the modest-dress norm. Fast-turning festive line, best margin in women's footwear.

skuLines.line: Kolhapuri / leather-look ethnic chappal
skuLines.examples: Kolhapuri handmade, Paragon ethnic, generic tan chappal
skuLines.notes: Token depth only; overlaps with jutti demand.

skuLines.line: Kids' occasion shoes — boys' formal, girls' party sandals
skuLines.examples: Bata Bubblegummers party, Liberty Footfun, Campus kids, Kittens girls
skuLines.seasonality: Annual Day, Founder's Day, Gurpurab, Diwali, weddings
skuLines.notes: Dated demand — buy against the school's event calendar, not the month. Miss the Annual Day and the stock sits a year.

skuLines.line: Kids' winter high-ankle boots / warm shoes
skuLines.examples: XMARTY zip boots, HOOH lace boots, Bata winter kids, Dedicated slip-on boots
skuLines.notes: Genuine hill-winter need for small children; a plains buyer would skip it. Order Sep — a January hill road is not a supply line.

skuLines.line: Industrial safety shoes — steel toe, ISI marked
skuLines.examples: Liberty Warrior, Hillson, Tiger, JK Steel, Vaultex
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; bulk at institutional issue cycles
skuLines.notes: Warehouse, maintenance, kitchen, boiler and construction staff on a township this size. Likely an institutional/bulk sale to the Trust rather than a walk-in — very different buying pattern, so ask the estate office for its issue cycle. Insist on the ISI/BIS mark; safety footwear is a regulated line.

skuLines.line: Non-slip kitchen / canteen clogs
skuLines.examples: Smoothlite healthcare clog, Doctor Health clog, generic anti-skid EVA clog
skuLines.notes: Two canteens plus a langar-scale kitchen — wet-floor slip risk is real and washable EVA is the right answer. Another likely institutional bulk line.

skuLines.line: Wax shoe polish tin — black, brown, tan
skuLines.examples: Cherry Blossom wax, Kiwi, Helios, Double Lips
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; spike Mar-Apr and before every parade/inspection
skuLines.notes: Compulsory hostel-kit item — 1,500 children in black school shoes need polish inspected weekly. Long shelf life, tiny cube, easy to hold deep stock. Small tins outsell large in a hostel.

skuLines.line: Liquid / instant shine polish with applicator
skuLines.examples: Cherry Blossom Liquid Wax Shine, Kiwi Express Shine, Quick liquid
skuLines.notes: Preferred by students because it needs no brush and no time. Check cap seals on arrival — hill road jolting causes leakage in cartons.

skuLines.line: White shoe whitener / canvas cleaner
skuLines.examples: Cherry Blossom White, Bonbella whitener, Color Zebra white, Kiwi white
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; hard spike before sports day, Annual Day, parades and inspections
skuLines.notes: The single most under-stocked school-adjacent SKU in India. White canvas PT shoes plus hill mud plus a weekly inspection equals a whitener sold every week per child. Sell it beside the canvas shoes, not in a chemicals aisle.

skuLines.line: Shoe brush, shine duster & applicator sponge
skuLines.examples: Cherry Blossom brush, generic wooden shoe brush, shine sponge, dauber
skuLines.notes: Every new admission needs one. Bundle brush + polish tin as a session-start hostel kit — higher basket, higher margin, and it saves the parent a decision.

skuLines.line: Shoelaces — black, white, brown; flat and round, multiple lengths
skuLines.examples: generic flat laces, Cherry Blossom laces, sports round laces
skuLines.packSizes: pair per pack; bulk bundles of 12
skuLines.notes: Trivially small, near-zero freight, absurd margin, and a snapped lace is a uniform violation the same morning. Carry 60cm/75cm/90cm/120cm — one length is not an assortment.

skuLines.line: Insoles — foam, gel, cut-to-fit; arch support
skuLines.examples: Frido gel insole, FOVERA, Dr Scholl's-style, generic memory foam
skuLines.notes: Extends the life of a pair the resident cannot easily replace — a genuinely useful line in a place 50 km from a shoe shop. Also the honest answer for foot pain instead of an over-claiming 'ortho' shoe.

skuLines.line: Heel grips, shoe-bite / anti-blister pads, silicone heel cups
skuLines.examples: FOVERA heel grip, betterhood silicone pads, Fidelis Healthcare heel cup
skuLines.seasonality: spike Mar-Apr when new school shoes are breaking in
skuLines.notes: New-shoe season is blister season across a whole residential school at once. Tiny, high-margin, and the correct attachment sell beside every school shoe.

skuLines.line: Shoe deodorizer spray / anti-odour foot powder
skuLines.examples: Cherry Blossom shoe fresh, Fixderma/generic shoe spray, foot powder
skuLines.notes: Closed shoes plus monsoon damp plus a shared hostel room — demand is obvious and seasonal. Aerosols on a hill road: keep out of direct sun in transit and storage.

skuLines.line: Leather cream / conditioner and suede-nubuck renovator
skuLines.examples: Cherry Blossom shoe cream, Woodland conditioner, suede renovator spray
skuLines.notes: The monsoon-protection sell for staff with formal leather shoes. Thin stock — one black cream, one neutral, one suede spray is enough.

trends2026: Clogs and EVA slip-ons (Crocs-style) have gone from a niche to a mainstream Indian category, with sub-₹500 domestic lookalikes from Aqualite, Smoothlite, CLYMB and Paragon driving most of the volume — a hostel/monsoon-perfect shape that barely existed in Indian general trade five years ago.

Athletic and athleisure footwear is the fastest-growing slice of the Indian market (~32% share, ~11.8% CAGR vs 9.7% overall), and 'sneakerisation' means the 18-25 cohort now buys a sneaker where it used to buy a formal or a canvas shoe.

Premiumisation is real but polarising: premium price points now hold roughly 54% of Indian footwear value, while the ₹200-500 EVA/soft-slipper tier grows on volume — the middle (₹700-1,200 unbranded formals) is the squeezed zone.

Extra-soft cushioned EVA slippers marketed on comfort ('Doctor Extra Soft', Solea Plus, Flite) have displaced plain Hawaii as the profit line, with retail prices 2-3x Hawaii for the same footprint of shelf.
Retro/chunky runners and all-white sneakers are the dominant 2025-26 style direction in Indian value sneakers, replacing the slim mesh running shoe as the default youth purchase.

Brands are pushing multi-brand houses down to Tier-2/3 and institutional buyers: Relaxo, Paragon, Liberty and Campus all now run 8-12 sub-brands specifically to hit different price ladders in one store, which lets a single-store retailer ladder ₹120 to ₹3,000 from two or three suppliers.

D2C and q-commerce have taken the accessory tail of the category (socks, shoe polish, whitener, insoles, laces) more than footwear itself — footwear stays a try-on, physical-store purchase, which structurally protects a captive-campus retailer.

Regulatory tightening on footwear quality (BIS/QCO activity and ISI marking on rubber, PVC and safety footwear) is squeezing the cheapest unbranded imports — I could not confirm the current Footwear QCO status or the post-September-2025 GST slab on footwear from a primary source in this session, so both should be verified before pricing and before any bulk safety-shoe buy.
adjacentServices: Shoe repair and resoling counter — stitching, sole replacement, heel tips, eyelet repair. In a township 30-50 km from a mochi, a repaired pair is often worth more to the resident than a new one, and it is nearly pure labour margin.

Session-start hostel footwear kit — school shoes + PT canvas + 5-pack socks + polish + brush + whitener + bathroom slippers, sold as one bundle against the school's own packing list. Raises basket, removes a parent decision, and pre-sells the March-April peak.

Institutional / bulk supply to The Kalgidhar Trust — safety shoes for estate and kitchen staff, gumboots for maintenance and farm, uniform school shoes and socks issued at admission. Different buying cycle, invoiced not billed, and forecastable a term ahead.

Size-run indent and pre-order book — take the size and take a deposit when a size is out, then consolidate into the next inbound freight. Converts the biggest stock-out loss in footwear (right shoe, wrong size) instead of sending the customer to town.
Shoe shine and polish service point outside the school assembly area or hostel block — small daily ticket, sells polish and whitener as attachment.
In-store polish and lace refill station plus a shoe-care demo at session start — teaches whitener/polish use to first-year hostellers and converts a one-time buy into a weekly repeat.
Sports-team and event fulfilment — buy court, stud and turf shoes against the sports department's actual fixture list and team roster instead of speculating, and offer team-order sizing on site.
Monsoon and winter pre-book campaign — take gumboot and woolen-sock orders in April-May and September respectively, so the hill road is crossed before the season, not during it.
